options: Observe or use evidence, connect it to the concept, and explain the conclusion.

flashcards.back: Define living characteristics, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define growth and movement, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define respiration and response, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define habitats, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore living characteristics
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on living characteristics. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where growth and movement is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach habitats to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
